heading: Tuesday Night
text: A few evening clouds, then mainly clear. Lows from the mid teens to lower 20s, cold hollows in the lower teens. Winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Sun filtering through occasional high clouds. High temperatures from the mid 30s to around 40 north, and low to mid 40s in the south. Light and variable winds.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows from the upper teens to mid 20s. Winds remaining light and variable.
